sentences.text: 02. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners-accused Nos.1 to 8 and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent - State.

03. Learned counsel for the petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 8 submitted that even prior to the present complaint, an FIR was registered by Police Langer House, Hyderabad in Crime No.244 of 2021 and thereafter charge sheet was filed on 04.02.2021, which is now pending as C.C.No.205 of 2022 before the learned VI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Nampally, Hyderabad.

entities.text: VI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Nampally, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 04. Having read the contents of the complaint in FIR No.244 of 2021 and also the private complaint filed before the learned XII Metropolitan Sessions Judge, Hyderabad, the contents are one and the same.

It is alleged in the both the cases that as on 23.07.2019 she was minor and she was married to accused No.1 and that after attaining majority she would be asked to lead marital life with accused No.1, however, accused No.1 had sexual intercourse with her, even prior to attaining majority.
05. Since the allegations in both the cases are one and the same, the procedure to be adopted is as stipulated under Section 210 of the Criminal Procedure Code.

In the circumstances, as per procedure laid down in under Section 210 (2) of the Criminal Procedure Code, both the cases shall be tried together as if complaint is outcome of case constituted on Police report.

06. In view of the above observations, the case pending in C.C.No.205 of 2022 before the learned VI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Nampally, Hyderabad, is transferred to the learned Special Court for the trial of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act Cases-cum-XII Additional Metropolitan Sessions Judge, Hyderabad and shall be tried along with S.C.PCS.No.146 of 2022.
